mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.5% (the current level) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises above 5.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a contraction in consumer demand that depresses corporate earnings growth expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate investment and profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 105.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 3.0% signals a loss of central bank credibility and potential for aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0% (y/y) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 100k (the current trend) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized signals a weakening economic expansion that reduces corporate profit growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is below 1.0% annualized over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 signals a strong manufacturing sector that boosts corporate investment and profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises above 115.0 over a 3-year rolling window.
